# Noor Al Huda Trading LLC

> UAE-based FMCG trading company supplying premium rice, spices, grains, pulses, flour and oils to hospitality, healthcare, retail and distribution partners worldwide. Established 2017. Headquartered in Dubai (Warsan 3 warehouse).

## About
- Legal name: Noor Al Huda Trading LLC
- Founded: 2017
- HQ: Warehouse #1, Warsan 3, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Phone: +971 58 589 9289
- Email: info@nooralhudatrading.com
- Languages: English, Arabic
- Markets served: GCC (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman, Kuwait, Bahrain), India, Pakistan, and worldwide export
- Customer types: 5-star hotels, hospital catering, retail chains, distributors, wholesalers

## Flagship products
- Basmati rice (Steam, Raw, White Sella, Golden Sella) — sourced from Punjab mills
- Sona Masoori rice — sourced from Telangana
- PR 11 rice
- Whole and ground spices (cumin, cardamom, cloves, turmeric, chili, masalas)
- Pulses & lentils (toor dal, moong, urad, chana, kidney beans)
- Wheat flour (atta, maida, semolina)
- Edible oils (sunflower, palm, soybean, olive)

## Packaging
- Bulk: 50kg, 25kg, 5kg jute and PP woven sacks
- Retail: 5kg, 10kg
- Private label and custom retail formats available
